quests.name: Seeds of Sustenance
quests.description: Seeds of Sustenance - The owner of the Spiced Honey Tavern has been having an issue keeping her pantry stocked, as goods have slowly but surely vanishing in the night. Worried about her customers going hungry, she reached out to you, hoping for a moment of your time.

steps.description: Only the best for Lira. I'll need to harvest some fresh produce, then hand it over.
It's a large fireplace, it'll take a lot of wood to fill, and a decent bit of effort to get it all burning.

quests.name: Packing Lunch
quests.description: Packing Lunch - A battle-hardened representative from the Slayers Guild has found himself without the majority of his supplies after a band of robbers stripped him of nearly all his possessions. In shockingly high spirits, the man still wishes to embark on a journey to the nearby Corrupted Farmlands, but will need to restock before he can.

steps.description: What would a man like him even like? Fish, maybe?
I need to make sure the bolts are well-made so they'll hold a man of that size, only way to do that is to do it myself.

quests.name: Morally Ethical Graverobbing
quests.description: Morally Ethical Grave Robbing - A long forgotten city filled with treasure, riches, and secrets beyond compare has just been uncovered... maybe. It's quite possible that there's hardly anything at all down there, but there's only one way to find out!

steps.description: Some steel for the heads, and willow logs for the shafts should be plenty strong enough.
I have the feeling I'm going to be here a while...
Morlin really isn't holding back on asking away, is he?

quests.name: Life's A Beach
quests.description:
Life's a Beach - While out for a lovely day of fishing along the Windswept Shores, you managed to find a catch you're not quite sure if you should toss back or not. The grumpy old man is a pain to deal with, but with enough time, he might warm up to you.

Or not.

steps.description: Maybe I'll reel it in, whatever it is.
I wonder if I should toss him back..?
How do people even use these things?

quests.name: Mage in the Making
quests.description: Mage in the Making - A young woman has been trying in vain to cram all of her studies into a few fraught hours before her mentor arrives to town, much to the dismay of Lira and her patrons.

steps.description: I'm sure nothing could possibly go wrong arming her.
I never fancied myself a teacher, but let's take a stab at it.
Maybe she'll be a bit better now?
Surely... Surely, teaching her to arm herself can't go wrong.

quests.name: Harvest Festival
quests.description: The Harvest Festival - Azamire's Annual Harvest Festival is right around the corner, and everyone is doing their part to help make it as great as it can be. Of course, the town will need your help to make it happen!

steps.description: I'm not too sure how much they'll need... let's get quite a bit.
I'm going to need you to grow... a bit faster.
Take one, cook it, pass it on. Take on, cook it, pass it on...
I hope these turn out nicely.

quests.name: Setting Down Roots
quests.description: Setting Down Roots - The Blackthorn Sisters have made one of their frequent appearances in Azamire, but seem to have brought a bit more than their usual cart of goods. What brings them to town today?

steps.description: I wonder what ever happened to this place?
I wonder what Clove might find for dinner. [Provide] X/X [Steel Arrows] - [Fletching Tab Link]
This stuff grows worse than most weeds. [Cut] X/X [Ambervine Bush] - [Woodcutting Tab Link]
Hopefully Petal hasn't severely poisoned the ground. [Plant] X/X [Sunflower] - [Farming Tab Link]

quests.name: A Glittering Trap
quests.description: A Glittering Trap - Gol has been tasked with taking down a beast near Azamire, and what good would a battle be without a friend by your side?

steps.description: Let's make sure these are sturdy enough to handle... whatever we're fighting. [Provide] X/X [Rune Spear] - [Fletching Tab Link]
I feel like I'm arming Gol for war, I hope whatever it is goes down quickly. [Provide] X/X [Rune Javelin] - [Fletching Tab Link]
Let's hope that payout is as good as he claims.
I'll make this extra messy, so it glows even brighter.

quests.name: The Four Sentries
quests.description: The Four Sentries - Morlin and his crew have made substantial progress in unearthing the lost civilization you helped uncover, but have run into another roadblock. With your help, perhaps you'll finally uncover the city proper?

steps.description: They're asking for stuff without even seeing me, now...
I'm sure this is what I need to do.
At least I know I'm helping her confidence.
You know, that old man makes a good point...

quests.name: The Sealed Grove
quests.description: The Sealed Grove - The leader of Azamire's forces has some concerns about a nearby grove that seems tainted by some kind of dark energy. With the situation beginning the spiral out of control, she has called in the best Azamire has to offer.

steps.description: These trees almost grow faster than I can chop them down!
Surely Gol will be able to handle... Whatever is in this forest.
This bait positively reeks, but that's kind of the point.
Rosemary is normally pretty pleasant. Will it really repel monsters with Petal's solution?
The runes the old man is asking for... This barrier seems like some nasty work.

quests.name: Pointy Preparation
quests.description: A concerned citizen wants to scrape together some semblance of a fighting force for Azamire's defense against any would-be bandits or those black-robed figures looking to finish the job, but she's barely in fighting shape herself.

steps.description: Just putting some pointy rocks on some wood, nothing too tough.
If I didn't know better, I'd say they were aiming at me.

quests.name: Fishin' for Trouble
quests.description: While out on a fishing trip, a little girl has gone missing with only her fishing pole and a single tooth left behind. Not much to go on, except one small detail. It isn't a human tooth.

steps.description: Swords are plenty sharp, that'll do.
Just catch some fish and don't look suspicious. Easy.
I'm not going to let [Companion Name] beat me!

quests.name: Boarish Bonfire
quests.description: Azamire has slowly but surely begun to get back onto its feet, and that's cause for celebration. The town's impromptu mayor, Hapren, has thought of just the thing to get folks together, a bit of warmth and food in the center of town.

steps.description: A little cleanup could go a long way to making things feel a bit more put together.
Nothing too flashy, just gotta pull up enough fish to show them how it's done.
There's no helping it, then!

quests.name: Misty Reconnaissance
quests.description: Gloob and Jass have been 'working' together for a while, and now need your help to launch a daring mission... or stupidly walk into a Golbin's trap.

steps.description: I should be able to follow Gloob's schematics easy enough.

quests.name: Rocky Rumble
quests.description: The old Northern Road will take Azamire's wagons close to the Ringleader's Fortress, but due to a rockslide, it's unusable. With a bit of effort, it should be usable once again!

steps.description: Chisel first, then make them into volatile bombs. Easy.
I don't suppose they're interested in talking this one out.
Maybe I should ask someone in the mines..? Nah, what's the worst that could happen?

quests.name: Dungeon Breakout
quests.description: A path must be cleared for the prisoners to get out of the Misty Thicket fortress when you launch the attack against the Ringleader, lest they get caught in the crossfire between you and the fortresses' guard.

steps.description: Gold coins aren't good enough, eh?
Just press it into the wall and cut, no problem.

quests.name: Tree Trimming
quests.description: [Companion Name] has been strangely absent lately, and on the rare chance you do see them, they usually quickly excuse themselves. What's going on?

steps.description: Good food always makes you feel better.
Time for a little bit of payback.
Let's make them a bit smaller, turned into ash.

quests.name: In the Thick of It
quests.description: Azamire is as ready as it ever will be to take down the Ringleader. The old Northern Road is clear, Jass's crew has finished the tunnel to the prison, and you have defeated the worst of the Misty Thicket's roaming guards. Now, all that's left to do is burn the fortress to the ground.

steps.description: If I want any supplies, I should take them from the cart before the attack starts in earnest.
We have to get through this gate!
We will not fall. Not this time.

quests.name: Sand in the Wind
quests.description: After a short stay back in Azamire, you and [Companion Name] find it hard to rest. There's still so much to be done. The Ringleader was merely the first step.

steps.description: They travelled a long, long way.
I should provide some basic supplies to help.
Wow, they're well stocked. That's helpful, at least.

quests.name: The Path to Melvor
quests.description: After pouring over the reports from Hirane's scouts, you're sure of one thing. The hooded figures that attacked Azamire and seem to be kidnapping and transporting townsfolk have headed far to the east. To what end, you couldn't even begin to wager a guess.

steps.description: With enough of these, we should be able to make it to Clearwater!
That hurt, but I guess it's fair.
Individually, these aren't too bad.
Hopefully this will persuade them to come out and say hello.
You'd really better taste good.
I mean... They won't mind if we borrow them, right?

quests.name: The Big City
quests.description: By following crumbs of information regarding the group you now know as the Soulsmiths, you've found yourself thrust into the middle of the capitol of Melvor with hardly a clue on what to do or where to go next.

steps.description: Here they come!
He'd better win.
None of this looks too rare, thankfully.

goals.label: Get Toxic Butterfly in a Jar

quests.name: The Ivory Athenaeum
quests.description: After helping Talm win Melvor's archery competition, you've done your part. Now, it's time for him to honor his side of the deal and hopefully provide information regarding the Soulsmiths.

steps.description: This mission might be next to impossible.
The vision proved particularly useful, didn't it?
I don't think he's going to let us out of here.
We need to escape, NOW!

quests.name: Unfortunate Teller
quests.description: After the miraculous heist of the Abyssal Vault, it's time to return to Era and Talm. Maybe they'll be able to tell you something about the book you managed to steal, considering you haven't the slightest clue on what it says.

steps.description: I doubt Talm will let us take his equipment after this. The recipe won't do us any good afterwards.
We can take them.

quests.name: Starlit Sky
quests.description: Talm has revealed himself to have some form of control over the dead, just like the Soulsmiths who burned your home. While he may hold no love for them after the kidnapping of Era, he has a lot to explain. Quickly.

steps.description: I need to improve my techniques.
Not these again...
What does Era wish for us to see?

quests.name: Cold Plunge
quests.description: The stars have finally shown you what you needed to see. A lone cold point, deep within the mountain range west of the capitol. That is your next target.

steps.description: Melting alone won't do it. We'll need to hack away at the ice, too.
Good morning?

quests.name: Ship Shape
quests.description: In their quest to find the shining tower shown to them by the history book stolen from the Ivory Athenaeum, [Player Name] and [Companion Name] find themselves travelling far north of the capitol, to a lonely little fishing village tucked into the coast.

steps.description: Head inland enough, should be able to grow something.
I'll need to make something that'll help it weather the rocky shore.
It can't be that hard, can it?

quests.name: The Sunken Tower
quests.description: All signs point to Gloomstone, and you're as ready as you'll ever be. It's time to learn what the Soulsmiths are after, or sink somewhere far off the coast.

steps.description: Astrology (Following stars through rocks)
I think we're doing them a favor.
This feels... right.
This is going to be extremely dangerous.
What happened to you..?

quests.name: MQ18
quests.description: What Comes After - After surviving Talm's initial onslaught, what will become of you next?

steps.description: What can you tell me? (Divination)
Bring me back to what you wish to show me. (Divination)

quests.name: MQ19
quests.description: The Price of Paradise - Little by little, Respite has begun to show you what it took to build, yet, you've only scratched the surface of what summoning has wrought upon the land.

steps.description: Damn him.
The Dreamers... what can they teach me?
[Exclusive Content Agility] X/X [Exclusive Content Agility]
This 'ought to be good!

quests.name: MQ20
quests.description: Path to the Peaks - The next leg of your journey has been laid out before you. The Perilous Peaks lay far to the north, the surrounding lands mostly untouched by civilization, but with no better leads, it remains your best path forward.

steps.description: I've got first watch, I suppose.
It looks like a whole pack has come out to greet us.
This is some of the toughest meat I've worked with...
It's almost like they don't want people coming up here!

quests.name: MQ21
quests.description: Dwarf Blood - With the sole Nalidasi guard unconscious at your feet and a gate blocking your path, you're going to have some explaining to do.

steps.description: It it a pull door..?
Let's see what this dwarf has got!
Don't have much of a choice now, do we?
Nothing too scary, then?

quests.name: MQ22
quests.description: Stoneway Yourway - After a warm welcome to the kingdom of the Nalidasi Dwarves, Princess Redilok is primed to accept your help in finishing the last of the Stoneway, which will earn your entry into the Royal Archives.

steps.description: I've been working on the Stoneeeeway~
Come on... Someone has to be out of place...
Oh no...

quests.name: MQ23
quests.description: Prince Procurement - After the Soulsmith attack on the Linking, you and [Companion Name] follow after Princess Redilok who is out for blood. Will you find the prince at the end of the path, or lose another royal in the process?

steps.description: I'll focus on breaking up the bigger rocks.
Please don't blow up, please don't blow up, please don't blo-
They have to pay.

quests.name: MQ24
quests.description: Repairing What Remains - The Soulsmiths successfully hijacked the Stoneglide and loaded it with explosives while those attending the Linking were preoccupied on all sides by assailants. Their efforts resulted in a massive swathe of Koganusan being reduced to rubble. Any amount of relief will go a long way towards caring for the populace.

steps.description: Her house simply isn't enough. How about a proper cookhouse? Maybe she'll be able to get some help then, too?
Do we just plant these in the ground or..?
This feels a little unorthodox.
A bit of this, and a bit of that...

quests.name: MQ25
quests.description: Slug Slayer - There's only one thing you've seen that can pierce the Soulsmith slug monster's thick flesh, and it's currently embeded within the chest of the Flamberian Prince. Surely he's willing to part with it... if he can.

steps.description: Should come to a point here, maybe a handle made of...
I wonder how Flamberian bodies handle stardust...
Just... stay still!

quests.name: MQ26
quests.description: Misty Mystery - The Soulsmith's Shambling Beast was last seen dragging its pitiful form north from the center of the Stoneway. As long as it didn't change directions, that'd place it somewhere within the Misty Thicket... an incredibly dense bog covered in a perpectual blanket of mist. The perfect place to go searching for a monster.

steps.description: What's going on up here?
Who's a good monster?
I feel soggy and miserable.
They started it.
Has to be what we're looking for.

quests.name: MQ27
quests.description: Bring Down The House - The weapon to defeat the Shambling Beast is ready, and a path to the Soulsmith's Ruin is cleared. Prince Cintak and Princess Redilok will lead their people into battle, with you and [Companion Name] at the head.

steps.description: I can't wait to see them in action.
I just have to reel them in before the shadows do.
Today, the beast dies.
